concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-internal-fund-transfers-scheduled-fund-transfers]] — 2020-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Marketplace account-to-account sweep guide for role/capability gates, account-time-zone cron, amount controls and two-sided booked-transfer evidence; optional examples drift into bank-payout fields.
warnings: A created/active sweep or Customer Area `Success` event means configuration/transfer creation, not an internal transfer booked on both sides or bank payout.

The optional dynamic-description example uses `transferInstrumentId` and bank-statement language despite core `counterparty.balanceAccountId` internal-transfer flow; `referenceForBeneficiary` versus `remittanceForBeneficiary` naming also conflicts.
The prerequisites list a Transfers API initiate role although the create operation is a Balance Platform Configuration API sweep endpoint; preserve this unresolved distinction.
